name: Exploding Offer Defusion (Farren’s Maneuver)
scenario: Enterprise vendor offers a 20% discount that expires at 5:00 PM today, demanding immediate signature.
script: "We are enthusiastic about this partnership, but our corporate governance mandates thorough risk and legal review. If this proposal must expire at 5:00 PM, we respect your schedule and will decline today; if you value our business, let us finalize terms on Tuesday."
defense: Stand by the deadline: implementation capacity closes today; unpaid at 5:00 PM, those engineers go to another client.
originFull: Scarcity Bias and Artificial Urgency Heuristics show that temporal deadlines are often manufactured to induce cognitive panic and force irrational agreement.
defenseFull: Enforcing a legitimate operational deadline: "Our technical implementation capacity for the quarter closes today. This is an operational reality: if this slot is not booked by 5:00 PM, those engineering resources will be allocated to another enterprise client."
